description: The plot illustrates the relationship between embedding layer and average correct gate rate for different input types and layer architectures. The x-axis, labeled “Embedding Layer,” is linear, ranging from 0 to 30 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Average Correct Gate Rate,” is linear, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A solid blue line represents “Character Attention input,” starting at approximately 0.2 and rising to a peak of about 0.75 at an embedding layer of 5 before decreasing to around 0.55 at an embedding layer of 30. A dashed blue line represents “Character MLP input,” beginning at approximately 0.75 and remaining between 0.8 and 0.95 across the entire range of the x-axis, eventually decreasing slightly to about 0.85 at an embedding layer of 30. A solid red line signifies “Wiki Attention input,” beginning at 0.2 and increasing to a maximum of about 0.85 at an embedding layer of 15, then decreasing to approximately 0.6 at an embedding layer of 30. A dashed red line indicates “Wiki MLP input,” starting at approximately 0.75 and remaining fairly constant between 0.8 and 0.9 across the x-axis, ending at a value of around 0.87 at an embedding layer of 30. Each line is accompanied by a shaded region representing the standard deviation.
